speaker: Tracey Joubert
title: Global CFO at Molson Coors Beverage Company
msg: Now, we plan to build on this very strong base through profitable growth and also a new cost savings program. Our solid cash generation has significantly strengthened our balance sheet. Now, moving forward, it should enable us to invest in ways that we believe will drive value for our shareholders. speaker: Tracey Joubert
title: Global CFO at Molson Coors Beverage Company
msg: The program anticipates savings across both our business units, and it'll also come through multiple lines in our P&L. This will be done through implementing new technologies, evaluating supply chain opportunities, and also portfolio optimization.

speaker: Tracey Joubert
title: Global CFO at Molson Coors Beverage Company

speaker: Tracey Joubert
title: Global CFO at Molson Coors Beverage Company

speaker: Tracey Joubert

speaker: Tracey Joubert
